question: Should the final implementation bound every nested string returned by `sanitizeToolResult`, or should it limit only the transcript-facing fields after preserving structured metadata for downstream consumers?
rationale: The PR establishes a shared truncation contract for persisted tool transcript data, and the existing evidence does not establish that every nested string is disposable transcript text.

options.title: Bound only transcript-facing payloads
options.body: Rebase the PR and narrow truncation to the serialization boundary, preserving structured metadata unless it is explicitly part of the transcript contract.

options.title: Accept broad deep-string truncation
options.body: Approve the current all-nested-string semantics after an owner confirms that every sanitized nested value is transcript-only and safely truncatable.

recommendation.title: Bound only transcript-facing payloads
recommendation.body: Rebase the PR and narrow truncation to the serialization boundary, preserving structured metadata unless it is explicitly part of the transcript contract.
